label: perf history: GLV-folded vs negation-folded factor base on one j = 0 curve
description: Frozen source of the j = 0 children in docs/perf/ecbench-children.json. Curve, target seed and factor-base seeds are those of research/isogeny_conductor_gap_round2_20261011 E2 (y^2 = x^3 + 15 over p = 2345743, r = 15937; the smaller of its two j = 0 craters, so the negation-only control stays under a minute of callgrind); the oracle is mitm:negation_folded=1 (as in research/ecbench_factor_bases_20261013 prime20) because mitm-fiber no longer runs on prime curves. Instruction counts only; the children are tracked by scripts/perf/perfhistory.py.
